svg.title: Consistent hashing
svg.desc: Left: ten keys placed with hash mod N. When a fifth server E is added, 8 of the 10 keys change server. Right: the same keys on a hash ring, each owned by the next server clockwise. Server E joins between B and C and takes only the 2 keys in its slice.
svg.text: Adding server E: mod N moves 8 of 10 keys. The ring moves only 2.
